equipment.name: Conversion field
equipment.desc: The model gains a 4+ ward save. If it makes at least one successfull save during its activation, to hit rolls against the model suffer a cumulative -1 penalty until the start of its next activation.

equipment.name: Eye of the Unseen
equipment.desc: The model gains the "Favoured Enemy" ability. Unique.

equipment.name: Foe-smiter
equipment.desc: One ranged weapon of the model gains the "Shred" ability. Unique.

equipment.name: Heavenfall blade
equipment.desc:
One melee weapon of the model gains one of the following:
- Additional +1 Strength
- Additional -1 AP
- Additional +1 AT
Every enhancement is unique per army.

equipment.name: Monster Slayer
equipment.desc: The model gains the "Tank hunter" ability.

equipment.name: Shroud of Heroes
equipment.desc: The model gains the "Stealth" ability, while it is not attached to a unit. Unique.

equipment.name: Teleport homing beacon
equipment.desc: A friendly unit arriving within 3" of the bearer via Deep Strike does not scatter. The Teleport homer must be present on the table at the beginning of the battle round in order to be used.

equipment.name: Eskaton Imperative
equipment.desc:
- Legion Destroyer Squads and Dreadwing Interemptor Squads may be taken as Troops.
- Before any models are deployed, you may choose to place one Eskaton marker (represented by any token no larger than a 25mm base) per 500 points of game size anywhere in the playing area that is 6" from a battlefield edge or any player’s Deployment Zone. The area within 3" of an Eskaton marker, including terrain pieces within the zone of this effect, are counted as Dangerous Terrain in addition to any other effects for the duration of the battle.

equipment.name: Storm of War
equipment.desc:
- Any unit with an attached character ignores negative leadership modifiers.
- No Legion Tactical Squad or Legion Despoiler Squad may take a Dedicated Transport.
